name: search-bar
title: Search Bar
description: Search field with a soft focus halo: the magnifier pops on focus, Cancel slides in as the field springs narrower, the clear button scales in and a spinning arc shows loading. Suggestions drop down in an animated panel with recent / trending icons and the matching text in bold; a trailing slot fits a filter or mic button. The minimal variant expands from a round icon.
props: Outlined pill, iOS grey field, or a round icon that expands into a field.
34 / 44 / 56pt tall; font, icons, padding and radius scale too.
Crossfades the magnifier into a spinning arc.
Slide a Cancel button in while searching.
After Cancel clears the query and blurs.
After the clear button empties the query.
Minimal only: where the collapsed icon rests.
Shown in a dropdown panel while focused; the matching text is bolded.
Called after a suggestion is picked (the query is set to its label).
Filter suggestions by the query. Turn off to filter them yourself.
Most rows shown in the panel.
Rendered inside the field on the right, e.g. a filter or mic button.
Focus ring, caret and Cancel colour.
Style for the root view around the field, cancel button and suggestions.
